main_text.p: luvione sua conspurcet: Ut si fieri poteft, maturè subducatur ex alveo; sin minus, & fundo quandoque se tollet, subsidere sensim finamus, ne turbato fonte potemus avidam & Scientiæ sitibundam juventutem. Hæc, cum paucis exsequor & cursim perstringo, tum id obnixè deprecor, quæ communiter dico, ne sic accipiatis, quasi in Cajum aut Sejum dicta sint: Indole sum alienissimus à faciendo conuicio: tum etiam particulatim ignarus, ut qui me nunquam interponam rei ad me non pertinenti.
Parergon illud, illuviem, inquam, Scientiarum nitidas lymphas inquinantem, eructant hæ quatuor potissimùm Cloacæ, PROLOGUS, PROGNOSIS, RHAPSODIA, & ANOMALIA. Ad PROLOGUM spectant

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment, the start of "fluvione" with the initial letter partly cut off; I have read it as "luvione" as printed on the scan. Possible misreadings: "luvione" may be "lavione" in the original; "Sejum" and "Cajum" are as printed.
